question: What should be the position of the ‘OFF’ marking on a fireman’s switch?
solution:
The correct answer is __At the top__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fireman’s switch__ is a critical safety device used in electrical systems.
 
• The ‘OFF’ marking on the switch should be located at __the top__.
 
• It ensures easy identification and accessibility during emergencies.
